verses.text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.

xrefs.text: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.

verses.text: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.

xrefs.text: “Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
Then He said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.’
Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. Where, O Death, are your plagues? Where, O Sheol, is your sting? Compassion is hidden from My eyes.

verses.text: So let us know— let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.

xrefs.text: I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

verses.text: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes.

xrefs.text: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

verses.text: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth, and My judgments go forth like lightning.

xrefs.text: “Is not My word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that smashes a rock?”
See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.”
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts says: “Because you have spoken this word, I will make My words a fire in your mouth and this people the wood it consumes.

but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.

verses.text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.

xrefs.text: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.

But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
“I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.

verses.text: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.

xrefs.text: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
Put the ram’s horn to your lips! An eagle looms over the house of the LORD, because the people have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law.
You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.
if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart,

verses.text: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with footprints of blood.

xrefs.text: Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field.
Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”
And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Mahanaim,

verses.text: Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.

xrefs.text: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
[“]Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
When I heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim will be exposed, as well as the crimes of Samaria. For they practice deceit and thieves break in; bandits raid in the streets.
Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.

verses.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: Ephraim practices prostitution there, and Israel is defiled.

xrefs.text: I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution; Israel is defiled.

And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: They commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns his back on wickedness. They are all like Sodom to Me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.”
A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land.

verses.text: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.

xrefs.text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.
For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled. In just a little while her harvest time will come.”
